description: Cysic has temporarily suspended its cross-chain bridge after an attacker allegedly exploited a database vulnerability and forged minting messages to create 10 million CYS tokens on BNB Smart Chain. The foundation said its mainnet remained unaffected, while investigations into the attack and potential financial losses continue. Authorities are still examining the remaining tokens and any proceeds from transfers.
title: Cysic Shuts Down Bridge After Attacker Illegally Creates 10 Million CYS Tokens

description: JPMorgan Chase has expanded its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum’s mainnet, giving eligible institutional clients another blockchain option for payments and settlements. The bank previously introduced the token on Coinbase’s Base network in November 2025. JPM Coin represents commercial bank deposits and operates through JPMorgan’s banking infrastructure, with access restricted to approved customers despite its availability on a public blockchain.
title: JPM Coin Arrives on Ethereum as JPMorgan Expands Institutional Payments

description: Airtel added three new voice-and-SMS-only prepaid recharge plans. They were launched after the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) directive on special tariff vouchers (STVs). The new Airtel prepaid plans are priced at Rs. 185, Rs. 203, and Rs. 206. They offer unlimited voice calling and a combined quota of 300 SMS. All three plans offer complimentary HelloTunes access.
title: Airtel’s New Recharges in India Announced: Rs. 185, Rs. 203 and Rs. 206 Voice-Only Plans Details

description: An unannounced Vivo smartphone bearing model number V2624 has appeared on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website in India. The model number is believed to be associated with the Vivo V80 FE. While the latest listing points towards a possible India launch, it does not disclose any hardware specifications or other details about the handset. The Vivo V80 FE is expected to come with upgrades over the Vivo V70 FE.
title: Vivo V80 FE Reportedly Spotted on BIS Certification Website, India Launch Seems Imminent

description: Vivo X500 Ultra will be launched in China between March and April next year, according to a tipster. Moreover, the rumoured Vivo X500 Ultra is expected to be powered by the flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 2nm process. The SoC features two prime cores, which deliver a peak clock speed of up to 5GHz. If this is true, it would be the first phone in the lineup to feature a Snapdragon SoC, as the Vivo X500 Pro Max gets a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. Apart from this, the Vivo X500 Ultra will reportedly launch with a 6.85-inch LTPO BOE display, which might offer “2K+” resolution and up to a 144Hz refresh rate. The screen could be surrounded by relatively thin bezels and rounded corners.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Leak Reveals Launch Timeline, Chipset, Display and Key Specifications

description: Redmi Pad 3 was spotted on Thailand's National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) certification website, the National Communications Commission (NCC) website and the UAE's Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) website. The Redmi Pad 3 is expected to offer battery and charging upgrades over the Redmi Pad 2. The NBTC listing shows the Redmi Pad 3 4G with model number 26104RPF2G and certification number B38693-26.
title: Redmi Pad 3 Spotted on Multiple Certification Sites Ahead of Launch; Key Specifications Revealed

description: After several leaks and rumours, Poco’s unannounced X8s’s moniker has finally been confirmed thanks to a certification website. The phone which showed up with a single model number on various certification websites across countries has now shown up on Thailand’s NBTC, but reveals no specifications.
title: Poco X8s Gets Listed on Another Certification Website, Hinting at Imminent Launch

description: iPhone Duo is equipped with a 4,883mAh battery at rated capacity, according to the European Product Registry for Energy Labelling (EPREL) database. The information is based on data provided by Apple in compliance with EU laws. It also has a claimed battery endurance of 51 hours and 30 minutes per cycle. However, during the keynote presentation on September 9, the tech giant said that the iPhone Duo provides “all-day battery life”. It is claimed to deliver up to 31 hours of video playback with the inner foldable screen. Meanwhile, with the cover display, the foldable is claimed to deliver up to 44 hours of video playback.
title: iPhone Duo Battery Capacity Revealed Days Before Foldable Goes on Sale

description: Qubic halted its layer-1 blockchain after attackers exploited weak wallet recovery seed generation to steal approximately 2.94 quadrillion QU tokens worth $1.4 million. The project said 87.1 percent of the stolen tokens remained on the network, while the rest was transferred to MEXC, which blocked the receiving account. Qubic has yet to announce a restart date as its team prepares recovery options for approval by network operators.
title: Qubic Halts Chain as Attacker Exploits Weak Seeds to Drain 1,400 Wallets

description: iQOO Neo 12 is scheduled to launch in China on October 28. Sales will begin shortly after the launch event. The company has revealed that the upcoming phone will be available in Contest, Shadow Black, and Frost Blade Blue (translated from Chinese) colour options. It will run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and the company's Q3 gaming chip. It will also have an Ice Dome active cooling system.
title: iQOO Neo 12 Launch Date Announced; Design, Colour Options Teased

description: OnePlus 16 was launched in China earlier this month. The phone now seems to be heading to global markets, including India. Software testing for the global variant is reportedly underway. OnePlus is reportedly testing global and Indian software versions of the OnePlus 16 under the model numbers CPH2901, CPH2903, and CPH2905. However, the company has not officially confirmed plans to bring the device to markets outside China.
title: OnePlus 16 Global and Indian Variants Reportedly Under Testing With Three Model Numbers

description: Apple's first MacBook model with a touchscreen and a Tandem OLED panel will go on sale globally on November 6, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest addition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. As part of the Apple Store “reset”, the tech giant will reportedly bring new signage and place new products on the store tables. Apart from the newly redesigned MacBook with an OLED touchscreen, the tech giant is reportedly planning to launch the iMac model with the new M6 chipset, the new MacBook Pro model with the M6 processor and a 14-inch display, and the refreshed iPad Mini with an OLED screen.
title: MacBook With OLED Touchscreen, New iPad Mini to Go On Sale Early Next Month as Apple Plans Store Overhaul: Report

description: Samsung launched the Galaxy F70 5G in India, and it will go on sale on October 20. The Samsung Galaxy F70 5G is a dual-SIM smartphone that ships with an unspecified version of Android-based One UI. It features a 6.7-inch Full-HD+ (1,080 × 2,340 pixels) Infinity-U sAMOLED display with up to a 90Hz refresh rate and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus. The phone is powered by an octa-core Exynos 1330 chipset, featuring six efficiency cores clocked at 2.0GHz and two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.4GHz. The tech giant claims that the phone ships with an IP54 rating for dust and splash resistance.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Apple is reportedly working on a higher-end version of its HomeView smart home hub. It could include a rotating, motorised robotic arm that turns toward the person interacting with the device. It could arrive as early as 2027. The device is reportedly in development under the codename J595.  The upcoming HomeView variant is expected to feature a roughly 9-inch display. The existing Apple HomeView sports a 7-inch Liquid Retina display.
title: Apple’s Next HomeView To Come With a Robotic Arm, Larger Display: Mark Gurman

description: Wallets holding between 10 and 10,000 BTC have accumulated nearly 86,000 Bitcoin since mid-September, even as spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net outflows of around $228 million during the week. Traders are also monitoring US inflation and the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy meeting.
title: Bitcoin Whales Add 86,000 BTC as Institutional Demand Weakens

description: Customers planning to walk into an Apple store on October 23 to buy the iPhone Duo may get a big shock instead. Apple previously announced that its first foldable, the iPhone Duo, would be available for purchase globally on October 23, but that option may no longer be available as the company struggles with stock shortages.
title: Apple May Not Entertain Walk-in Purchases for iPhone Duo on October 23 Due to Stock Shortage: Report

description: Samsung is reportedly planning a major overhaul with the next-generation One UI 10 update. According to a report, the company is planning to launch the new Android 18-based One UI 10 in the middle of next year. The software could be launched along with the rumoured Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 and Galaxy Z Flip 9. As part of the overhaul, the One UI 10 update will reportedly change the way users will interact with apps. The OS version is said to bring related information points together to display them in a single “contextual interface”. The report highlights that calendar events, location details, and relevant conversations will be made more accessible via connected workflows.
title: Goodbye One UI? Samsung’s Next Android Update May Be Renamed Galaxy OS

description: Redmi K100 will be launched in China on October 27 at 7:00 pm local time (4:30 pm IST), the company announced on Monday. The smartphone maker has announced that the Redmi K100 will go on sale via the Xiaomi online store in at least a Fluorescent Green (translated from Chinese) colour option. The handset will sport a flat 6.83-inch display, delivering up to a 165Hz refresh rate. Moreover, a hole-punch display cutout appears at the top, which will house the selfie camera. The tech firm claims that the Redmi K100 will support native 165 fps gaming on more than 40 games. The handset will ship with Xiaomi’s latest HyperOS 4, which is based on Android 17.
title: Redmi K100 Launch Date Announced Along With Display Features, Colourway and More
